outfit.name: 高街水洗廓形卫衣与机能皮环私服
outfit.prose: A heavy-wash charcoal grey oversized drop-shoulder hoodie hitting mid-thigh, layered over tight black bike shorts. A matte black utility leather leg harness with a miniature silver snap-hook gently pinches the bare thigh flesh, paired with slouchy white crew socks and high-top skate shoes.
